section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes the data collection methods for a study using opportunistic snowball sampling to recruit participants from the community. Participants completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires anonymously, and researchers developed German versions of the BAS (Body Appreciation Scale) and BES scales using the parallel blind translation technique to maintain translation quality.
